review.why: Check that every reference exists and matches its record, and catch invented, mismatched or retracted citations before submission.
review.summary: Rules plus a standard-library script that checks a .bib file or DOIs against Crossref, DataCite, OpenAlex and arXiv, gives one status per entry, flags retractions and expressions of concern, and can annotate unverified entries.
strengths: Clear rules: a resolving DOI alone proves nothing, unverifiable references are marked, and only mechanical fixes are applied without the user.
The script needs no dependencies, reports nine distinct statuses and separates a failed lookup from a bad reference.
Handles hard cases: conference papers without DOIs, preprints, datasets and software, retractions.
cautions: Sends reference titles, authors and DOIs to Crossref, DataCite, OpenAlex and arXiv, and a CROSSREF_MAILTO address if set, so details of an unpublished manuscript leave the machine.
The opt-in --annotate flag rewrites the .bib file in place (entry bodies are not changed); keep a copy.
Absence from these indexes is common for old, non-English or grey literature. The script was read in full but not run here.
